plates.kitchen: the inside of a modest old Filipino provincial house kitchen and dining room, wooden table with a steaming clay pot of soup and plates of rice, capiz window with afternoon light, old family photos on the wooden wall, warm cosy colours.
plates.shrine: the Aguinaldo Shrine in Kawit, Cavite, Philippines today: a large old Filipino mansion of dark wood and white stone, with a tall square tower of several storeys with small windows rising from the middle of the house, red tiled roofs, wooden window shutters, a wide green lawn in front, blue sky, bright daylight. A civic heritage house, no cross, no church, no steeple, no spire, no religious statue. Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame.
plates.kawit1898: the garden in front of a big two-storey wooden and stone Filipino house in Kawit in June 1898, a huge crowd of villagers seen from behind in straw hats and white shirts, an open upper window of the house, coconut palms, festive golden afternoon light.
plates.sky1898: a bright golden afternoon sky over the tiled roof and open upper windows of a big Filipino house in 1898, coconut palm tops, light rays, no flag.

One woman and one child only.

The dog's left ear stands upright and pointed, only the dog's right ear is folded down; the dog's face is all black with no white on it, the white patch is only on the dog's chest. Sitting, looking up at the viewer with a cheeky warning look, one eyebrow raised, mouth closed. The red kerchief is plain red with no green.

full.flag: the Philippine flag, blue stripe on top and red stripe below with a white triangle bearing a golden sun and three stars, waving on a pole that leans out of an open upper window with wooden shutters on the flat front wall of a big two-storey wooden and stone Filipino house in Kawit, Philippines, in 1898, nobody visible in the window, no balcony, no railing; at the bottom, the backs of the heads and straw hats of a calm crowd of villagers in white shirts seen from behind, arms down, golden afternoon light rays. Single image, no panels, no border.
